infrastructureAsCodeIssues.title: S3 Bucket has public read access
infrastructureAsCodeIssues.description: Public read access to S3 buckets can lead to unintended exposure of sensitive data.
infrastructureAsCodeIssues.impact: Data stored in the bucket can be accessed by anyone on the internet.
infrastructureAsCodeIssues.resolve: Remove public read access and restrict access using bucket policies or IAM roles.
